column6: query

Among human studies synthesized in systematic reviews or meta-analyses, which blood or cerebrospinal fluid protein, metabolite, or nucleic-acid biomarkers sampled within 72 hours show the highest diagnostic accuracy for rapid acute ischemic stroke diagnosis and differentiation from stroke mimics or non-stroke controls, using diffusion-sequence MRI as the reference standard and allowing stratification by clinically relevant early therapeutic time windows?

How does L-carnitine supplementation affect cardiac function, oxidative stress markers, systemic inflammation, mortality, reinfarction risk, arrhythmias, and heart failure outcomes in patients with coronary artery disease, across preclinical animal studies, case reports, observational studies, randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses?

Among adults with heart failure, how do multivariable regression and machine-learning prognostic models developed or externally validated using demographic, socioeconomic, and clinical predictors perform over 1 to 5 years in predicting overall mortality, heart-failure-related or all-cause hospitalization, emergency department use, and stroke or other major adverse cardiovascular outcomes, based on cohort, case-control, and observational studies, and what predictive performance measures (especially the C-statistic) are reported?

In full-text primary studies of surgically managed spinal cord cavernous malformations published from 1995 to 2025, which demographic, baseline clinical, neurological, radiological, and surgical variables are reported, how complete and consistent is this reporting, and what temporal or geographic trends and reporting gaps are evident across eligible prospective studies (>=10 patients), retrospective studies (>=20 patients), and any randomized trials?

What is the prevalence of hallucinogen use or hallucinogen use disorder among adolescents (mean age <18 years) with early-onset psychosis diagnosed by DSM or ICD criteria (including schizophrenia spectrum disorders), what are its clinical correlates and effects on illness course, and what is the association between hallucinogen exposure and psychotic or psychotic-like symptoms in general community adolescent samples, based on cross-sectional and longitudinal observational studies?

How are digital biomarkers (e.g., heart rate variability, physical activity, sleep patterns, skin conductance) measured by research- or consumer-grade wrist-worn wearables associated with generalized anxiety disorder or anxiety symptoms, assessed using validated self-report questionnaires or clinical diagnoses, in adults (mean age >18 years), based on cross-sectional and longitudinal studies using inferential statistics or machine learning methods?

What depression symptoms 窶・including somatic and psychological manifestations 窶・are experienced by adults (竕･18 years) from the South Asian diaspora (Afghan, Bangladeshi, Bhutanese, Indian, Maldivian, Nepalese, Pakistani, or Sri Lankan heritage) living in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, and how do acculturation and intra-ethnic differences shape symptom expression relative to ICD-11 criteria, based on original qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods studies as well as grey literature such as NHS reports and government briefings?

What are the safety outcomes (adverse events, complications) and effectiveness (prevention of infection, hospitalization, and death) of vaccinia-based mpox and historical smallpox vaccines when administered during pregnancy (any trimester) or to neonates, children, or adolescents (<18 years), based on randomized controlled trials, quasi-experimental studies, cohort studies, case-control studies, cross-sectional studies, and case series or case reports for novel adverse events?

What are the differences between resorbable and non-resorbable membranes in new bone formation, graft stability, membrane exposure, graft loss, infection, undesirable bone resorption, and reoperation rates in patients undergoing guided bone regeneration, based on randomized controlled trials and comparative clinical studies?

In individuals of any age with long COVID defined as persistence or recurrence of symptoms at least 12 weeks after confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, what is the frequency and range of genitourinary manifestations including renal dysfunction, urinary symptoms, erectile dysfunction, scrotal pain, epididymo-orchitis, and menstrual alterations, based on cross-sectional, cohort, and case-control observational studies?

In randomized controlled trials of patients with non-communicable diseases characterized by inflammatory processes and oxidative stress, how does clearly defined probiotic supplementation (single- or multi-strain, with specified dose and duration) compared with placebo affect oxidative and nitrosative stress markers, oxidative biomolecule damage, and related inflammatory biomarkers, when adequate quantitative outcome data are available?

In adults with rheumatoid arthritis-related pain, what is the comparative effectiveness of pharmaceutical analgesic therapies (including NSAIDs, opioids, acetaminophen/paracetamol, COX-2 inhibitors, biologics, and corticosteroids) and non-pharmaceutical interventions (including physical, occupational, behavioral, and device-based therapies such as acupuncture, thermotherapy, ultrasound, laser therapy, electrotherapy, hypnotherapy, and balneotherapy) on pain relief, pain intensity reduction, and maintenance of pain symptoms, based on randomized controlled trials, prospective or retrospective cohort studies, and case-control studies?

In women, what is the association between a history of oral contraceptive (OC) use and the risk of clearly diagnosed rheumatoid arthritis (RA), compared with healthy participants without OC exposure, based on prospective or retrospective cohort studies reporting quantitative effect estimates (hazard ratios or relative risks)?

In humans, human-derived cell models, and established in vivo arthritis/inflammation/oxidative-stress models, how do Ilex paraguariensis (yerba mate) preparations (traditional infusions, aqueous or hydroalcoholic extracts, and commercial formulations) and major isolated constituents (chlorogenic/caffeoylquinic acids, quercetin, rutin) affect rheumatoid arthritis-relevant outcomes, including DAS28, CRP, ESR, systemic inflammatory and oxidative biomarkers, and mechanistic pathways (NF-kappaB, JAK/STAT, Nrf2, fibroblast-like synoviocyte behavior, cytokine release, and RANKL/OPG), based on randomized or non-randomized clinical trials, observational studies, human in vitro studies, and in vivo animal studies, using the review's time windows (10 years for yerba mate preparations; 5 years for isolated compounds)?

Since January 2001 through October 2023, which studies have developed, validated, or evaluated rheumatoid arthritis (RA)-specific referral criteria, or inflammatory/early arthritis criteria explicitly directed to RA diagnosis, for use in referral from primary care (e.g., GPs) to rheumatology specialists, with no language restriction, while excluding generic non-disease-specific rheumatology referral tools, patient-only self-report screening tools, and general-population pre-GP screening approaches?

In adults with rheumatoid arthritis (defined by 1987 ACR, 2010 ACR/EULAR, or physician diagnosis), what is the effect of smart healthcare interventions (e.g., mobile/online symptom-tracking and self-management platforms, telemedicine, teleconsultation, automated monitoring, and remote follow-up) on disease activity, self-efficacy, self-management, functional status, quality of life, and adverse events, compared with control conditions, based on randomized controlled trials reporting outcomes attributable to the smart-health component?

Across global populations, what is the association between rheumatoid arthritis and stroke risk, based on cohort or cross-sectional studies with clear diagnoses of both RA and stroke and reporting quantitative effect estimates (odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals)?

In patients with incidentally detected solitary pulmonary nodules (SPNs; rounded lesions <=3 cm on imaging without prior malignancy suspicion), what is the pooled malignancy rate and which risk factors are associated with malignant versus benign outcomes, based on observational studies using rigorous outcome verification (malignancy by histopathology; benign status by histopathology, >=24-month stability/regression on follow-up imaging, or characteristic benign calcification), with risk factors included when reported in at least three independent studies?

How feasible, acceptable, and effective are digitally delivered multimodal prehabilitation interventions 窶・combining physical exercise, nutritional support, and psychological components delivered via wearable fitness trackers, telehealth platforms, or mobile health applications 窶・for adults (竕･18 years) with cancer prior to surgery, chemotherapy, or radiotherapy, based on quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods studies?

In adults (>=18 years) who survived non-Hodgkin lymphoma and completed primary treatment (excluding recurrence and on-treatment populations), what factors influence post-treatment quality of life across quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods evidence, in inpatient, outpatient, or home settings, based on original studies published in 2014-2025 in English?

In adult women with confirmed breast cancer, what associations are reported between germline genetic variants (including SNPs and pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline mutations) and time-to-event prognosis outcomes (DFS, OS, BCSS, PFS, MFS), based on studies published from January 2000 to June 2024 that provide adjusted effect estimates, regardless of language?

In patients with advanced gastric or colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases, what treatment-related adverse events and complications are associated with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) compared with non-HIPEC control treatment, based on English-language randomized controlled trials with convertible/reportable safety outcome data?

In colorectal cancer patients, how is expression of heat shock proteins (HSP subtypes) associated with prognosis outcomes (OS, DFS, PFS, EFS, RFS, CSS), based on fully published English prospective or retrospective cohort studies and clinical trials reporting or permitting calculation of hazard ratios with 95% confidence intervals?

In patients with unilateral sporadic vestibular schwannoma managed with wait-and-scan, stereotactic radiosurgery, or microsurgery, what PANQOL total and domain quality-of-life scores are reported, and how do these strategies differ, based on original peer-reviewed studies with at least 1-year follow-up after diagnosis (W&S) or treatment (SRS/MS), per-protocol majority evaluation, and extractable PANQOL data (English or Dutch full text)?

column1: # PubmedID: PubMed identifier (PMID) of the source systematic review
# Set: Training (used for hypothesis accumulation n=11) or Test (held-out evaluation n=24)
# Domain: Clinical domain abbreviation・CV=Cardiovascular PSY=Psychiatry  INF=Infectious Diseases RA=Rheumatoid Arthritis ONC=Oncology
# gold_count: Number of gold-standard PubMed articles included in the systematic review (ground truth for recall calculation)
# query: Natural-language research question used as LLM input for Stage 1 query generation
# PRISMA_JBI: Whether the SR reported adherence to PRISMA
# RoB: Whether the SR used a formal risk-of-bias or quality assessment tool
# Dual_Reviewer: Whether two or more independent reviewers performed study selection and/or data extraction (Yes/No)
# Broad review type: Post hoc descriptive review-type classification used for cutoff-sensitivity subgroup plots; not used for model training, rulebook refinement, or cutoff selection.
